text:
sam_deploy: Starting rollout to prod-slice-3 now. Canary window: 10m, 5 req/min. Image: rwd-infer:v1.12.3. I’ll hand off smoke checks once canary is healthy.

deploy-bot: Rollout started -> canary 1/4 deployed. (auto-progressing)

maya: grabbing smoke checklist, will run quick probes once canary reaches 5/5. ping me for any fixes.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 5/5 ✅

maya: running quick health checks:
- curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROD_TOKEN" https://api.prod.redwood/v1/health || echo FAIL
- ./scripts/send-smoke --model gpt-medium --seq 64 --count 6
- check logs for 5xx in the last 5m: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --since=5m | grep -E "5.." || echo none`

maya: first smoke run: all 6 completions returned, token counts and content look fine. no obvious hallucination spike.

jon_k: watching p95/p99 latency -> initial bump to 110ms p95 during warmup then back to ~75ms. CPU on gpu-pool-7 hitting 82% briefly. Will keep an eye, alert if p95 > 120ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

ash (ash): saw a single 503 at 21:07 correlated with a client retry flood (old client that retries aggressively). tracing shows `x-request-id` f3a8... from service-internal A. Not systemic.

maya: re-ran smoke with longer prompt templates (few-shot) — completions look fine, throughput ok. posting a small diff to the hotpatch branch if anyone wants to sanity-check content changes: `git diff origin/main...hot/smoke-typo-fix`

sam_deploy: Good. Roll to 50% now. Keep rollback command handy: `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=rwd-infer:v1.12.2 -n prod` (note: v1.12.2 stable image).

deploy-bot: Rollout at 50% -> no errors reported in 4m. Proceeding to 100%.

jon_k: No metric regressions. SLOs stable. Minor GPU memory pressure on node gpu-7 but no OOM.

ash: following up on client retries — filing a tiny fix in clients repo (will ship as non-blocking patch). Not rolling back for that.

maya: final quick smoke after 100%: 10/10 passes, sample QA prompts look okay. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to prod-slice-3. Canary -> global.

sam_deploy: Thanks all — staying in watch for another 20m then I'll mark the deploy as closed if quiet. If you spot anything odd, ping here and add #ops-incident if it needs escalation.

jon_k: noted, watching dashboards.

maya: leaving a short checklist in the ticket with commands and sample outputs.

ash: ack - patch PR #482 queued for client retry fix.

sam_deploy: Closing note (in ~20m) if no flags. Great job crew. :party_parrot:
